description.description: A sequence of four frames showing two young women taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a restroom. In the first and second frames, they are seen posing and adjusting their hair; a person wearing a traditional Shtreimel (fur hat) and long black coat is partially visible in the background. In the third and fourth frames, the camera focuses on the individual in the Shtreimel and long coat, who is washing their hands at a sink while a third woman in olive green clothing walks by in the background.
